projecthero.guide.omnitrix.alien.brainst: A Cerebrocrustacean: a crab-like genius whose head shell opens on a huge brain that throws high-voltage lightning -- bolts, chain lightning that jumps from foe to foe, a crackling orb, a force-field bubble that stops shots, and an electric storm cloud for his ultimate. Lightning never hurts him, but water shorts him out.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.brainstorm.rol: Electrokinetic genius: lightning bolts, chains and storms, a force field and a read on any foe.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.brainstorm.pas: Genius: Genius Analysis reads a creature's health, armour and weak spot -- his moves hit it 25% harder for 10 s.
Crab shell: armour 6, and big pincer claws (+3 to his punch).
projecthero.omnitrix.info.brainstorm.wea: Water shorts him out: standing in water, his electric moves deal half damage.
A heavy shell on small legs: he walks at 0.9x speed.
projecthero.omnitrix.brainstorm.lightnin: A bolt of lightning from his claws at the creature under the crosshair (20 blocks): 7.
projecthero.omnitrix.brainstorm.chain_li: A bolt at the creature you look at (20 blocks) for 14 that jumps on to the nearest foe within 7, four times: 12 each.
projecthero.omnitrix.brainstorm.arc_pinc: A crackling snap of his claws at everything in front of him (3.5 blocks): 13, stunned for 1 s.
projecthero.omnitrix.brainstorm.ball_lig: A slow, crackling orb of lightning that bursts on whatever it touches: up to 16 within 3.5 blocks.
projecthero.omnitrix.brainstorm.static_h: A charged leap forward. No fall damage until he lands.
projecthero.omnitrix.brainstorm.bolt_das: He crackles 8 blocks ahead as a bolt of lightning (stopped by walls): 6 to everything he passes through.
projecthero.omnitrix.brainstorm.discharg: His whole body discharges: every creature within 5 blocks takes 17 and is thrown back.
projecthero.omnitrix.brainstorm.mega_bol: A second's charge with the shell wide open, then a huge beam of lightning along the crosshair (24 blocks): 19 to everything in its path.
projecthero.omnitrix.brainstorm.genius_a: Reads the creature you look at (24 blocks): its health, armour and weak spot in chat. It glows, and his moves hit it 25% harder for 10 s.
projecthero.omnitrix.brainstorm.force_fi: A bubble of electric force round him for 6 s: projectiles never get through (they bounce off), other damage is cut by 60% and creatures are pushed out of it.
projecthero.omnitrix.brainstorm.electric: ULTIMATE: a storm cloud gathers over where you look (24 blocks) for 6 s; every half second lightning strikes every foe under it (8 blocks) for 5 -- up to 60.
projecthero.omnitrix.brainstorm.static_c: Bars of lightning slam down round the creature you look at (16 blocks): 12, and it is stunned in the cage for 3 s.
An arthropod: Bane of Arthropods works.
Heavily armoured: go for its joints.
No obvious weakness -- just hit it harder.
